name: @pipeworx/mcp-hathitrust

tools.name: lookup_by_identifier
tools.description: Look up HathiTrust's digitized-book holdings by a standard identifier (OCLC, LCCN, ISSN, ISBN, HathiTrust item id, or catalog record number). Returns the bibliographic record(s) plus every scanned copy, each flagged full-view (readable online) or limited (search-only) based on its rights code. Keyless — covers 18M+ volumes. Requires a free Pipeworx account (https://pipeworx.io/signup); anonymous and X-API-Key-only calls are refused.

id_type.description: Identifier type. One of: oclc, lccn, issn, isbn, htid, recordnumber.

id.description: The identifier value, e.g. "424023" for an OCLC number, "9780030110405" for an ISBN.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get a single HathiTrust catalog record by its record number, with the full structured bibliographic metadata (titles, ISBNs, ISSNs, OCLCs, LCCNs, publish dates, record URL) and the complete list of scanned copies flagged full-view vs limited. e.g. record_number "009166282" ("A manual for the study of insects"). Keyless. Requires a free Pipeworx account (https://pipeworx.io/signup); anonymous and X-API-Key-only calls are refused.

record_number.description: A HathiTrust catalog record number, e.g. "009166282". Obtain one from lookup_by_identifier (the record_number field).

tools.name: check_full_view
tools.description: Convenience check: given an identifier, report whether a readable (full-view) scanned copy exists on HathiTrust, how many copies are readable, and direct reading URLs. Keyless. Requires a free Pipeworx account (https://pipeworx.io/signup); anonymous and X-API-Key-only calls are refused.

id_type.description: Identifier type. One of: oclc, lccn, issn, isbn, htid, recordnumber.

id.description: The identifier value, e.g. "2364951" for an OCLC number.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hathitrust forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hathitrust pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
